title: Priority customer 5xx tracer and staged failover swiftpatch
creator: Marta Ruiz
description: Customer reported repeated 5xx spikes during concurrent tenant bursts. Scope: Hosted API only (edge + runtime path). Observed pattern: tenant-level request storms causing inflight KV lease churn, amplified retries from SDK clients, and fallback hotpaths triggering runtime cold paths. Hypothesis: failure amplification is caused by a combination of short-lived KV lease revocations and our existing retry/hedging policies. This ticket implements two primary mitigations: (1) lightweight 5xx tracer sampling to quickly classify root-cause dimensions per-tenant/request (transport vs runtime serialization vs kvcache eviction), and (2) a staged failover path that transparently routes affected tenant traffic to a warm fallback variant (compat-mode runtime with conservative batching + restricted concurrency) while preserving idempotency and customer session affinity.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Triage by oncall (Marta): reproduced customer trace locally using tenant-sampled replay. Confirmed intermittent 502/504 originating from runtime serialization pause when KV lease revocation happens during concurrent batch commits.

2026-03-11 - Design decision (Kevin): implement an ephemeral per-tenant tracer that attaches a lightweight trace-id to a 3% sample of requests. Tracer captures: request headers, runtime kernel path, kvcache lease events, and client retry headers. Reason: faster RCA without high-cardinality logs. Trade-off: minimal overhead (~0.5% p99 token latency) vs faster containment and targeted failover.

2026-03-11 - Mitigation prototype (Eng): small runtime shim that detects kvcache lease storms and flips tenant into 'quarantine' state. Quarantine routes to a compatibility runtime with reduced concurrency and enforced idempotency checks. Early results in staging: 78% reduction in tenant-caused 5xx bursts during synthetic load.

2026-03-12 - PR opened: runtime patch + tracer (GH#1489). Notes in PR: feature gated behind runtime-1.22 flag 'tenant_quarantine' and default sampling set to 3%. Request reviewers: @leah, @omar, @kevinz.

2026-03-12 - PM feedback (Ravi): ensure customer comms template is ready for tenants moved to fallback; include expected transient latency bump and instructions to opt out. Also requested SLA annotation in the console for impacted tenants.

2026-03-13 - Design review (Leah - Observability): add a derived metric 'tenant_quarantine_rate' and a dashboard panel and alert (warn at 1% sustained for 10m). Important for rollout gating. Also added an async job to bulk-export tracer samples to the diagnostics bucket with redaction rules.

2026-03-13 - Ops runbook updated: step-by-step to manually flip tenant into quarantine, verify idempotency tokens, and rollback to normal routing. Included command snippets and expected Grafana panels. Link in attachments.

2026-03-14 - QA (Nora): completed synthetic soak of staged failover across us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Findings: small latency increase (p95 +45ms) but 0 downstream 5xx in 4h soak on affected tenants. Discovered edge-case: websocket streaming connections drop when routed to compatibility runtime; added plan to stream-bridge connections for next minor patch.
2026-03-14 - Customer comms draft (Ravi): emailed affected customer with temporary mitigations and ETA for full rollout. Coordinated with CSM for personalized follow-ups.

Next steps - short term: land GH#1489 behind feature-flag, deploy to canary in us-east-1, enable tracer sampling at 1% for production telemetry, monitor quarantine_rate + rollback gate. Long term: evaluate kvcache lease algorithm to reduce revocations, and add SDK guidance for exponential jitter to avoid synchronized retries.
